senses.gloss: etto, adv. (= Pali id.; abl.), in yāva(d) etto, up to this point (yāvat with abl., as in both Skt. and Pali): Mv 〔i.327.20〕; 〔329.5〕; in both read, as clearly indicated by the mss. despite some corruption, yāvad etto pi ativiśvasto, even to such an extent very intimate (wrongly Senart).
